updateserver.name: zGod
updateserver.desc: Everything on the panel in one place, across every reseller: each account's package, reseller, disk and bandwidth against its quotas, websites, databases, mailboxes, FTP and cron jobs; the server's totals; suspend an account or switch a mailbox off; a daily report by email. For administrators. (The ZPanel classic, written again for Sentora-2027.)
